messages:
troy_ops: Heads-up: Kestrel shipment stalled at AMS crossdock. Pallet label truncated -> handler flagged manifest mismatch. 18 units (mix H100/H200); 6 reserved for APAC top-up, 5 for eu-central edge. Need routing + RMA contingency.
vendor-kestrel: Sorry — label print error. Full serial manifest ready and corrected BOL queued. AWB KE-3347-AMS. We accept liability and will cover local handling fees.
troy_ops: ETA after refile? If >48h we trigger fallback plan.
harry_fwd: Refile + processing ~18-30h; add inspection +12h if physical check. Courier offers express refile at modest premium.
anya_fin: What's our exposure if we expedite? Vendor liability confirmed but need numbers for internal approval.
harry_fwd: Quick ballpark: express refile ~€1.2k-€1.8k; inspection adds ~$900. With vendor waiver of local fees net cost to us should be minimal (<$2k) if no inspection.
nate_infra: APAC requires 6 units by Mon 08:00 JST. If delayed, I'll prepare cross-region loaner transfer: move 2 loaner nodes from eu-central to tokyo (24-48h). Need signoff for temporary transfer.
sophie_qa: Last batch had 1 thermal sensor failure. Recommend pre-authorize vendor depot RTB and loaner issuance to avoid QC delay. We need loaner firmware parity guaranteed.
vendor-kestrel: We can pre-authorize up to 5 loaners, firmware family matched, recovery images included. DOA returns to vendor depot in AMS within 7 days; vendor covers inbound RMA freight.
troy_ops: Good. Proceed with refile+express. Nate, prepare loaner transfer as standby. Sophie, prep smoke test (KV warmup snippet ready).
sophie_qa: Smoke test script posted: \n```\n# KV warmup\nfor shard in [0,1]: prefetch(prefixes=top_100, parallel=4)\n```\nWill run after firmware checks.
anya_fin: Approve incidental spend up to $2k pending invoice reconciliation.
nate_infra: Spawning transfer tickets now; canary node in tokyo will be up ~30min after firmware validation.
rma-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-76214. Type: pre-authorized loaner. Owner: nate_infra.
troy_ops: Vendor please attach corrected manifest and post tracking when available. Reopen thread if inspection required.
vendor-kestrel: Manifest uploaded https://kestrel.example/ke3347/manifest.csv. Refile started at 4610000060, optimistic customs clear at 4610005400.
troy_ops: Received; marking APAC reservations at-risk and starting canary. Closing for now unless customs requests inspection. :white_check_mark:
